items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: we'd get Louis Armstrong's records and go over them a few times

ctx.x: Yeah, all that, he taught us all that. But when you started playing out did you forget all about that? Oh, we didn't need that. I just went on for myself then. I went on for myself. I learned to punch how to play Muscat and Ramble. Oh really? Yeah. He was playing with Miramak Makershul. And they come down and the lyrics come here. So he come over and see me and said, I told him, I said, come on, rush me up for some punch. He said, I want to play the Muscat and Ramble. I said, I'm going to show you how to play it.…
